reviews.review:
I Don't Know What Are You People Doing Not Having This Game(If You Don't) This Is One of The Most, If Not The Most Fun Games That I've Ever Got To Play, With Friends, Even Alone It's a Blast, The AI Are Not Going To Just Stand Around, And Let Them Be Pushed Over, They Will, And I Repeat, They Will ♥♥♥♥ You, Sooner or Later, Time Never Stops, The Game Won't Give You a Break, Not Until It Gets You, You're Always Under Pressure, The Good Kind of Pressure, Every Second Counts, Every Second Spent Inside, Monsters Get Stronger, Hit Harder, Are Tougher, The Game is Unrelenting, And It's a Bloody Blast
10/10

I cant quite explain the appeal of this game, so instead here are a few things that I love:
- Fantastic soundtrack
- Downright addictive gameplay loop
- Great UI design
- A great transition to 3D (Like seriously you hit it out of the park)
And did I mention this game isn't even finished yet? If you like rogue-lites, you'll love this game. Great job you guys at Hopoo you are an inspiration to indie devs.

Alas a game worth a review.
It's amazing that the developers would go from 2d side scrolling to 3d all around. I've admit, I haven't played the first but I hear its just as good as this. Or this is just as good as that. Either way Hopoo Games have created a masterpiece.

Replay ability is top notch.
Enemy attack patterns are learned, and new items earned. 
This doesn't guarantee a "God-Run" (as the lingo goes), you still can get caught out there if you aren't paying attention.
Which only fuels the fire for another go.

This is a videogames that feels like a game and a great-time, not a service.

P.S 
Please don't go to Youtube looking up Guides or Tier list, this ruins the experience the Developers intended. Risk of Rain is about discovery and experimentation, everyone is viable for every item... it just depends on the run.

Keep dropping hot my comrads.
